description: A test script for Git push.default settings, including setup of repositories, testing various push behaviors, and workflows involving upstream, current, matching, simple, and default push configurations.

methods.name: check_pushed_commit
methods.description: Checks that the latest commit in a local revision matches the remote revision.

methods.name: test_push_success
methods.description: Tests that a push with specified push.default value succeeds and the expected commit is pushed.

methods.name: test_push_failure
methods.description: Tests that a push with specified push.default value fails and no remote branches are modified.

methods.name: test_pushdefault_workflow
methods.description: Tests push behavior under different workflows and push.default settings, including central and triangular workflows.
